thread:
anya (CS): BeaconX onboarding - seeing 429s on SDK preflight during high-concurrency tests. Staging region us-east-1. Repro: spawn 200 parallel inits. Logs show `HTTP/1.1 429` with body `quota_exceeded`.

matt (eng): Thanks. Can you paste the client init snippet? Are you using ephemeral tokens or static API key?

anya (CS): Ephemeral via our onboarding flow (short-lived JWTs). Here's the init call:

```
fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v1/sdk/init', {
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <ephemeral_jwt>' },
  method: 'POST'
})
```

kai (devex): Does the app call preflight for every tab? 200 parallel inits sounds like stampede. Any splay logic?

anya (CS): No splay in their test harness. They spin up workers with identical start time. We tried adding `initConcurrency: 10` but still see spikes in first minute.

matt (eng): Likely preflight fanout hitting per-tenant handshake limit. Two quick mitigations: 1) increase client-side jitter/splay, 2) server-side accept short warmup TTL (we can allow burst if tokens share JWT family). Also check token `iat`/`exp` skew.

anya (CS): We inspected JWTs — exp is 60s, but clients sometimes request immediately after refresh so multiple fresh tokens created almost same time. Any server-side levers we can toggle for onboarding sandbox?

matt (eng): I can flip a temporary 'onboard-burst' policy for BeaconX to raise preflight window to 3s and increase allowed concurrent handshakes to 60 for 1 hour. Will monitor.

onboarding-bot: New escalation created: #CS-7890 for BeaconX 429 fanout. Assigned to matt. ETA 1h for policy flip.

anya (CS): Adding note: customer uses browser SDK with service worker initiating multiple tabs; recommend server-side token coalescing too.

kai (devex): Docs follow-up: add example for `initConcurrency` + `splayMs` and recommended ephemeral TTL 120s for high-parallel warmup. I'll draft.

matt (eng): Policy flipped. Please retest and paste a short flamegraph if still seeing 429s. I'll also check edge logs for `x-preflight-family` header.

anya (CS): Retest in 2 mins. I'll ping with results. :thumbsup: 

anya (CS): Retest results: still some 429s (~5%), but much lower. Sending sample request/response pair:

`REQUEST: POST /init ... Authorization: Bearer eyJ...`
`RESPONSE: 429 {"err":"preflight_quota","retry_after":2}`

matt (eng): That's better. 5% indicates remaining collisions. Can you enable client-side exponential backoff with randomized base jitter? Try 150-600ms.

anya (CS): Will do. Also logging shows mixed iat values by <2s; probably clock skew on their CI nodes.

kai (devex): Add note in onboarding checklist: "Ensure CI nodes NTP sync; prefer ephemeral token reuse across worker pool if possible."

anya (CS): Closing loop once they confirm. Thanks all!
